name: IIM Mumbai

about.text: Formerly known as NITIE (National Institute of Industrial Engineering), IIM Mumbai has carried on the rich traditions of the institution’s prowess in management education. With the advent of the digital era, IIM Mumbai has updated its curriculum according to industry needs. It stays connected with industry partners from the business capital of India, Mumbai itself. Ranked among India’s top B-schools of India, IIM Mumbai has been ranked 6th in the management category of NIRF Rankings 2024. Established in 1963, this institute has been around for a long while, upskilling students into skilled professionals in diverse functional areas such as Finance, Analytics, Project Management, HR, Operations Management, Sustainability Management, and Information Technology.

The mode of education in this institute for graduate degrees and postgraduate degrees is offline since these programs are full-time residential. The faculty consists of more than 59 academicians who are highly qualified experts. The students get to meet industry experts through the institute’s connections with its industry partners which help in integrating practical knowledge based on industry insight with classroom teaching. Across many of the programs, 1200 students are learning and growing their academic prowess, getting prepared to face the dynamic industry challenges.

IIM Mumbai has also been accredited by AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business), an accreditation body that credits institutions providing management education at undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels. The programs offered by IIM Mumbai are MBAs, PGDEx-VLFM (Postgraduate Diploma for Executives-Visionary Leaders For Manufacturing), Ph.D., General Management Programme for the Defence officers(DGMP), online MDPs (Management Development Programmes) and several certificate courses meant to specialize in a particular field. The institute has partnered up with many companies that provide placements for the students such as 3M, Abbott, AB InBev, Cipla, John Deere, Aditya Birla Group, EY, etc.

about.text: IIM Mumbai has partnered with foreign universities to conduct student exchange programs and lectures by eminent professors from these universities in North America, South America, Europe, and South-East Asia. This institute aims to produce professionals who will have a higher impact on the corporate structure as well as its output on the nation’s development as business leaders. Thus it aims to lead the field of management education in churning out leadership skills among their students that are meant to be used for making a huge impact on society.

facts: IIM Mumbai stands for Indian Institute of Management Mumbai.
IIM Mumbai is ranked 6th in the NIRF Rankings 2024 in the management category.
It used to be known as the National Institute of Industrial Engineering (NITIE).
It is located in the business capital of India, Mumbai, and consists of several major industries, industrial experts, and pioneers.
Part of the cluster of IIMs (Indian Institute of Management) spread across the country providing management education.
This institute provides programmes in MBA, PGDEx-VLFM, PhD, and certificate courses.

This institute has partnered up with multiple companies to recruit students for career prospects. Some of the hiring companies are 3M, Abbott, AB InBev, Cipla, John Deere, Aditya Birla Group, EY, etc.
This institute provides management education that is industry-oriented with a faculty consisting of more than 59 in-house instructors and also includes professors from foreign universities.
The institute has an alumni network of 10K people.

admission.text: The following is a step-by-step process of getting admission into IIM Mumbai
Step 1- The candidate should start by applying online and getting registered at the application portal.
Step 2- Upload the required documents online.
Step 3- Based on the details and documents provided, candidates will be shortlisted for an aptitude test and an interview.
Step 4- The student’s final score will be evaluated based on factors such as his/her past academic performance, aptitude test, interview etc.
Step 5- Once cleared and selected, the student will join the institute on the day of the commencement of classes.

examination.text: IIM Mumbai’s examination and evaluation pattern is set in such a way that it enhances and preserves whatever the student is learning. Using experiential learning to register whatever is learned, the student gets to go through testing formats and understand the subject. There are group exercises that test the student’s ability to cooperate and collaborate. Then there are case studies that broaden perspectives and develop the skillset through the main insights derived from the case study. One could apply concepts and theories to make a project that tests the ability to create something new or discover new paradigms out of the existing knowledge and concepts. Then final exams are held that evaluate the total knowledge, concepts and skills, in order to solidify them.

placementText.text: IIM Mumbai has a good rapport with its company partners who participate in placement rounds. These companies provide placements for worthy students who aim to excel in their careers. A few students get somewhere near the highest salary package, while the remaining get an average salary, and higher or lower than that. IIM Mumbai has partnered with a plethora of companies such as 3M, Abbott, AB InBev, Cipla, John Deere, Aditya Birla Group, EY, etc for it’s placement events. These placement events advance a student’s career by empowering their skills and knowledge to be applied to the screening tests and interviews taken by the placement representative of the hiring company.
